name: Seafrigo
verdict: Owned by family holding Seafrigo Investissements (president Eric Barbe). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Le Havre cold-chain logistics group founded by Eric Barbe in 1979; chaired by his private holding company Seafrigo Investissements. Credit Mutuel Equity and BNP Paribas Developpement sit on its supervisory board, but no state or fund control is named. Front-of-shirt principal partner from 2026-27 (previously 2017-2020).
